issuing_body: German National Disease Management Guideline (NVL) programme

treatments.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease
treatments.summary: Drug choice should consider cardiovascular and renal risk; GLP-1 receptor agonists lowered all-cause mortality in people with cardiovascular disease.

evidence.quote: Cardiovascular and renal risks are to be considered in the choice of drug.
evidence.statement: Cardiovascular and renal risk should guide which glucose-lowering drug is chosen.

evidence.quote: in persons with cardiovascular disease, treatment with GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1, glucagon-like peptide-1) or SGLT2 inhibitors (SGLT2, sodium-glucose co-transporter-2) was less likely than the comparison intervention to lead to certain patient-relevant endpoints, including all-cause mortality (OR = 0.88 and 0.84, respectively)
evidence.statement: In people with cardiovascular disease, GLP-1 receptor agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors lowered the odds of all-cause mortality versus comparators.

milestones.label: German NDMG pharmacotherapy recommendations (reaffirmed in 2023)
milestones.quote: Current evidence continues to support the recommendations on pharmacotherapy of the 2021 guideline.

treatments.name: SGLT2 inhibitors
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease
treatments.summary: Lowered all-cause mortality, heart-failure hospitalisation and worsening renal function in people with cardiovascular disease.

evidence.quote: in persons with cardiovascular disease, treatment with GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1, glucagon-like peptide-1) or SGLT2 inhibitors (SGLT2, sodium-glucose co-transporter-2) was less likely than the comparison intervention to lead to certain patient-relevant endpoints, including all-cause mortality (OR = 0.88 and 0.84, respectively)
evidence.statement: In people with cardiovascular disease, GLP-1 receptor agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors lowered the odds of all-cause mortality versus comparators.

evidence.quote: hospitalization for heart failure (SGLT2 inhibitors: OR = 0.65)
evidence.statement: SGLT2 inhibitors also lowered the odds of hospitalisation for heart failure.

treatments.name: Shared decision making
treatments.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes whose individual treatment goals have not been achieved
treatments.summary: A structured shared-decision-making approach is described for when individual goals are not met.

evidence.quote: The new chapter on shared decision making includes a description of a structured approach that can be used when individual treatment goals have not been achieved.
evidence.statement: The guideline adds a structured shared-decision-making process.

treatments.name: HbA1c target values
treatments.summary: The guideline group made no recommendation on HbA1c target values because evidence certainty was inadequate.

evidence.quote: The Guideline Group did not find evidence of adequate certainty to inform recommendations about the screening of persons at risk, HbA1c target values, or screening for sequelae and comorbidities.
evidence.statement: No recommendation on HbA1c target values was made due to insufficient evidence certainty.

notes: German national guideline; pharmacotherapy recommendations of the 2021 version reaffirmed.
